components.why: Root pom.xml declares 8 child modules (bom, tools, test, api, web, webapp, liquibase, test-suite); only api and webapp have oracle pom.xml files, so 6 modules are unlabeled. The root component openmrs is complete from pom.xml.

deployables.why: The Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml are fully covered by oracle files, yielding the container_build and two Compose services. Additional Compose override files (docker-compose.override.yml) and grafana/elasticsearch variants are out of oracle scope.

interfaces.why: EXPOSE 8080 in Dockerfile and ports 8080:8080 in docker-compose.yml are labeled. The docker-compose.override.yml adds port 3306 for the db service, but that file is not in oracle scope.

capabilities.why: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch capabilities are labeled from api/pom.xml runtime dependencies. The full dependency list (Hibernate ORM, Spring Security, Lucene, etc.) was not exhaustively mapped to capabilities; only those with clear catalog matches are labeled.

edges.why: member_of and depends_on_local edges for oracle-scope components are labeled; 6 unlabeled modules prevent complete workspace membership coverage. The Compose depends_on and Dockerfile builds edges are labeled. No runs edge is labeled because the Compose api service image name (openmrs/openmrs-core) does not directly match a component name.

notes: webapp/pom.xml finalName uses the Maven property ${webapp.name}, which is defined in webapp/pom.xml line 207 as 'openmrs'; the resolved WAR artifact name is openmrs.war.

The mariadb-java-client dependency is labeled under datastore:mysql because MariaDB uses the MySQL wire protocol and is used as a MySQL-compatible datastore in OpenMRS deployments; the catalog does not have a separate datastore:mariadb entry.
api/pom.xml declares both MySQL and PostgreSQL JDBC drivers as runtime dependencies, reflecting OpenMRS's support for multiple relational databases selectable by configuration.

The Dockerfile's dev stage (line 64: FROM maven:3.9 AS dev) and runtime stage (line 125: FROM tomcat:11) both declare EXPOSE 8080; only the runtime stage port is labeled as the primary interface since it is the production deployable.
Six Maven modules (bom, tools, test, web, liquibase, test-suite) are listed in root pom.xml but their pom.xml files are not oracle files; they are unlabeled components.
